description: This file contains test functions that simulate user interactions with a CodeMirror editor instance, particularly testing emacs-like keybindings and commands.

methods.name: fakeEvent(keyName)
methods.description: Creates a mock keyboard event with specific key modifiers based on the key name.

methods.name: sim(name, start )
methods.description: Simulates a sequence of key presses and actions in the CodeMirror instance, setting up the test environment.

methods.name: dialog(answer)
methods.description: Creates a function that simulates opening a dialog and automatically providing an answer.

methods.name: at(line, ch, sticky)
methods.description: Returns a function that asserts the cursor is at a specific position.

methods.name: txt(str)
methods.description: Returns a function that asserts the editor's content matches a specific string.
